notes: This FAQ page looks old. It links to 2019 Rec-PAC sites. Check the fee, dates and deadline with the Park Authority at 703-324-8700 before you apply.
name: Rec-PAC Counselor-in-Training (C.I.T.)
what_you_do: Help staff at summer Rec-PAC school sites, RECenters, parks and camps run by the Park Authority.
who_can_apply: Any teen aged 14 to 17. Rec-PAC school sites have no interview; camp sites at Rec Centers and parks need an interview.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Counts as volunteer hours. The FAQ lists a $160 fee for the whole summer at school-based Rec-PAC sites.
duration: At least one week encouraged, up to the full summer; school sites run 8:15 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday to Friday
deadline_text: FAQ says Rec-PAC applications were due June 14 (page does not give a year). Rec Center sites: contact the site to set an interview.
how_to_apply: Rec-PAC school sites: fill out the application and return it to the Rec-PAC office. Rec Center and park camp sites: contact the site for an interview. All CITs attend a 3-hour training and pass a knowledge test.
